loader.author: LavaGang
loader.description: Loads the three installed gameplay plugins. Its proxy must be enabled for them to run. Initial startup generates game assemblies and can take several minutes.
loader.source_note: Official GitHub release. No verified Nexus page for this game's loader setup.
loader.image_note: This framework has no separate gameplay effect to illustrate. See GitHub for its documentation.

build-liberator.author: Fr4nsson
build-liberator.description: Makes rune and gem extraction/insertion free while retaining the source equipment. Useful for trying different builds at Eleanor. Existing rune-slot and weapon-category limits still apply.
build-liberator.source_note: Author's Nexus page. No verified public GitHub repository found.

rune-details.author: vergir
rune-details.description: Adds damage, healing, resource costs and timing information to rune tooltips. Brief appends a short note; Detailed shows separate statistics. It changes displayed information and does not add combat slots.
rune-details.source_note: Both pages belong to the mod's author. Images show author examples, not a test of this installation.

images.caption: Detailed mode: damage, costs, cast times and effects. Use 100% to read each tooltip.
Brief mode: compact extra information in each rune description.

wicked-menu.author: theSchlooper
wicked-menu.description: Opens portable town services for selling, repairing, enchanting, infusing and managing runes. Fast travel requires it to be unlocked in the realm. Use the menu key chosen in Options; this setup initially uses F12.
wicked-menu.source_note: Author's Nexus page. No verified public GitHub repository found.

images.caption: Author's overview image, with portable service choices at the left.
